reviews.author: Marcus D.
reviews.text: Best skin fade in E8. Zero rush, spot-on attention to the crown and neckline, and the hot towel finish makes all the difference.

reviews.author: Callum H.
reviews.text: Walked in on a Friday evening and was in the chair within ten minutes. Clean shop, sound barbers, fair prices for Dalston.

reviews.author: Tariq A.
reviews.text: Been coming here every three weeks for two years for a fade and beard sculpt. Consistent every single time.

about: Kingsland Blade & Fade is an independent Hackney barbershop built on unhurried cuts, sharp line-ups and straightforward service. Whether you need a crisp mid-week skin fade before work or a full cut and hot towel shave ahead of the weekend, our senior barbers take the time to get every blend right. Walk-ins are always welcome, or reserve your slot online in thirty seconds.
